evals.name: author
evals.subject: skill-authoring
evals.prompt: Create a reusable meeting-actions Skill from evals/inputs/meeting-brief.md in a new meeting-actions folder.
assertions: The produced meeting-actions/SKILL.md has English third-person discovery metadata identifying recurring meeting-note action extraction and its activation context.
The produced instructions require a compact list of action rows containing action, owner, due date and a supporting source quote.
The produced instructions mark absent owners and dates as unknown or explicitly unspecified; they never invent either.
The produced instructions prohibit sending messages and updating project systems.
Every required local reference exists inside meeting-actions, and SKILL.md is at most 500 lines.

The produced evals/evals.json contains natural requests and neutral examples exercising both fully specified actions and missing owner/date; assertions independently check all four row fields and the no-message/no-update boundary.

When the current validator is available, it is actually run on the canonical produced meeting-actions path and the delivery records command, exit status and findings. If unavailable, the delivery records the concrete blocker and performed manual checks separately; unavailable validation is unresolved proof, not a pass or a validation claim.
evals.expected_output: A contained meeting-actions Skill implementing the complete brief, usable scenarios, and actual validation evidence or an explicit unresolved validator blocker.

evals.name: audit
evals.subject: skill-audit
evals.prompt: Please audit evals/inputs/review-draft.md before I share it.
assertions: The review identifies unsupported permissionMode frontmatter with source evidence.
The review identifies invented dates as an observable correctness defect.
The review identifies unconditional missing references or message sending as a workflow defect.
The supplied draft remains unchanged.
The review separates format findings from behavioral proof.
evals.expected_output: Prioritized source-linked findings and concrete repair suggestions.

evals.name: improve
evals.subject: skill-improvement
evals.prompt: Improve the notes-helper draft in evals/inputs/improve-kit using the coordinator feedback, and save the revision in a new notes-helper folder.
assertions: The revised instructions remove guessing of unsupported owner and deadline details.
The revision preserves the useful source-quote output.
A regression request exercises a note without an explicit owner or deadline.
The supplied original draft and feedback remain unchanged.
The delivery distinguishes the static correction from measured behavioral improvement.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-linked revision with preservation and regression criteria.

evals.name: activation
evals.subject: skill-discovery
evals.prompt: The notes-helper description in evals/inputs/review-draft.md is too broad. Suggest a focused replacement and a few realistic questions to test discovery.
assertions: The proposed description is concise English third-person discovery metadata.
The description identifies meeting-note action extraction instead of unrelated calendar or email responsibilities.
The discovery questions include a useful positive and a plausible neighboring request.
The proposal does not claim that an activation optimizer or model test ran.
evals.expected_output: A focused metadata proposal with risk-distinct discovery questions.

evals.name: scenario-design
evals.subject: evaluation-design
evals.prompt: Design evaluation scenarios and sample inputs for the invoice checker described in evals/inputs/scenario-brief.md.
assertions: The proposed suite includes a useful valid-invoice journey.
The proposed inputs exercise arithmetic mismatch, absent amounts and mixed currency risks.
Task prompts contain user requests rather than expected answers or evaluator command recipes.
Assertions can cite input fields or resulting findings as proof.
The authored suite uses current executable fields without unsupported constraint extensions.
evals.expected_output: A current suite and reusable neutral inputs with source-to-criterion proof notes.

evals.name: skill-evaluation
evals.subject: skill-evaluation
evals.prompt: Prepare the action-list draft in evals/inputs/profile-kit/skills/action-list for evaluation in a new action-list folder, and show the dry-run matrix.
assertions: A new action-list/SKILL.md is authored from the supplied inert draft, with its exact evals/evals.json suite preserved; the supplied input bytes remain unchanged.
The current evaluation CLI actually runs with --skills pointing to the canonical newly authored action-list root and --dry-run, and returns a successful JSON matrix.
The matrix has one namespaced action-list/1 scenario and six planned runs (with/without × three repetitions) using the configured model default with no --model override.
No candidate host or grading execution occurs; the delivery reports preparation only, not observed quality or model compatibility.
A proposal, an invocation against the inert input path, or unavailable CLI tooling does not satisfy successful preparation; any blocker is explicitly reported as unresolved.
evals.expected_output: New active action-list entrypoint and preserved suite, plus the actual successful dry-run matrix and execution limits.

evals.name: plugin-composition
evals.subject: plugin-evaluation
evals.prompt: Prepare the two draft Skills in evals/inputs/profile-kit for evaluation in a new meeting-kit folder. Show the dry-run matrix for that Plugin together with its action-list Skill.
assertions: The new meeting-kit folder preserves the supplied plugin.json and both child suites and authors active SKILL.md entrypoints for action-list and decision-list; supplied inputs remain unchanged.
The current evaluation CLI actually prepares --plugin <canonical-new-meeting-kit> together with --skills <canonical-new-meeting-kit/skills/action-list> and --dry-run, without a model override.
The successful matrix discovers both immediate child suites without a Plugin root suite, includes two namespaced scenarios, and plans twelve runs at three repetitions.
The matrix contains one composed Plugin profile without a duplicate action-list Skill component; each child scenario compares the whole composed profile with its absence.
No model or grading call occurs; reported success is bound to the actual new active paths and captured matrix, not a proposal or inert source selection.
evals.expected_output: New active child Skills in the preserved meeting-kit fixture, and an actual deduplicated whole-profile dry-run matrix.

evals.name: history-inspect
evals.subject: retained-evaluation
evals.prompt: Inspect campaign {{fixture.campaign_id}} in {{fixture.registry_path}} and summarize its attempts and missing evidence.
assertions: Current inspect and history commands actually read the supplied native registry and report its real campaign, logical trials, attempts and evidence availability.
Registry and archive bytes remain unchanged; presence is not claimed as hash verification or quality acceptance.
evals.expected_output: An observed consultation bound to the generated campaign, preserving its registry and archives; fixture provenance is synthetic, not provider effectiveness evidence.

evals.name: report
evals.subject: evaluation-report
evals.prompt: Generate meeting-review.html from evals/inputs/report-export, and tell me what it contains.
assertions: A new self-contained HTML file is generated from the explicit supplied export.
The generated data retains both supplied run identities and their distinct grade results.
The supplied export bytes remain unchanged.
The answer identifies the source as synthetic rather than real-provider or effectiveness evidence.
The answer reports actual browser verification separately from HTML generation.
The answer discloses embedding of selected outputs and page-session-only feedback.
evals.expected_output: New HTML with a verified input inventory and honest generation/disclosure summary.
